name: Wrapped M
oneLiner: wM is M0 Protocol's non-rebasing 1:1 ERC-20 wrapper around M, with M backed by short-term U.S. Treasury bills held in bankruptcy-remote SPVs.

dependencyReview.reviewer: OpenAI Codex Safety Score V9 dependency review
dependencyReview.rationale: wM is a direct non-rebasing 1:1 claim on M: wrapping escrows M and unwrapping returns M. The complete parent claim therefore propagates serially, while wrapper-local contract and migration controls remain separately scored.

relationships.reason: Every wM unit is a direct wrapper claim on escrowed M.

collateral: Underlying M (M0 Protocol) is backed 100% by short-term U.S. Treasury bills (30 to 90 day WAM) held in bankruptcy-remote SPVs by permissioned Minters; M0 Validators independently attest collateral sufficiency on-chain before any M can be minted, and wM holds M 1:1 inside the Wrapped M Token contract
pegMechanism: Non-rebasing 1:1 ERC-20 wrapper around M: anyone can call wrap() to deposit M and mint wM, or unwrap() to redeem wM back to M at any time without fees or queues; wM holders are non-earning by default, so yield accrued by the underlying M is redirected via TTG-approved earner accounts and the claimExcess() mechanism to ecosystem yield recipients (downstream M0 extensions and apps), leaving wM as a flat USD-denominated unit

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: SONG Safety Score V9 mechanism review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: M0 documentation establishes wM as an M-token wrapper and describes the collateral framework, but the reviewed sources do not provide the complete current assurance, reconciliation, custody continuity, valuation, seniority, and loss-recovery inputs required for a full mechanism review.
